statement: Cannabis production workplaces can involve chemical, biological, ergonomic or physical, and safety hazards, including chemical exposures, allergenic biological materials, heat or noise, electrical hazards, and slips, trips, or falls.

review.rationale: Drafted from a reviewed NIOSH cannabis workplace-hazards source and cross-checked against the current NIOSH page on September 15, 2026. The statement stays at hazard-category level and avoids unsupported frequency or risk estimates. Lesson 13 is included only for pre-use hazard recognition; this claim does not establish maintenance authorization or lockout/tagout requirements.
review.notes: Human scientific review is required before promotion.

sourceContext.contextTitle: Pre-use checks protect safety and process reliability
